label: Calm product
instruction: Use the supplied product image as evidence, with a separate readable text region. Keep exact facts, copy, palette and assets. Choose a side-by-side or stacked layout from the aspect and material. Let text settle early and hold; do not invent a launch sequence or product claims.

provenance.adaptation: Original 2D separated regions and bounded native opacity/y arrival; no camera, per-word spans, drift, weight600 or upstream quality claims. Timings are own 30fps defaults.
